description:
Match upstream pi-mono's 5-step model resolution (see
`tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/model-resolver.ts`
`resolveInitialModel`):

1. CLI flags (`--provider X --model Y`) win everything.
2. Scoped models from per-project config (minimatch pattern →
   provider + model). Skipped when resuming a session.
3. Saved default from ~/.pi/settings.json (defaultProvider +
   defaultModelId).
4. First available model with configured API-key auth, walked
   in the provider-declaration order from the
   `defaultModelPerProvider` table. Inside each provider, picks
   that provider's default id.
5. Errors out when no configured auth found.

Plus: alias-vs-dated-id preference for reproducibility on
resumed sessions (prefer `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` over the
alias `claude-sonnet-4-5`).

What we have now (`OctoPi.Coder.CLI.resolve_model/1`):
- Hardcoded `claude-opus-4-6` (matches upstream's anthropic
  default).
- `--model` flag override.
- Nothing else.

Subscope:
- Port the provider table (we currently only have anthropic, so
  this grows as Phase 5 providers land — align with octo-l8r).
- ~/.pi/settings.json read/write (persistent defaultProvider +
  defaultModelId).
- Scoped-model per-project config (RESEARCH.md §? — check).
- "First available with valid auth" fallback — requires knowing
  which providers have auth configured; ties into OAuth phase
  (opi-y1y).

Landing priority: after the core provider set (Phase 5) is in
place. Interim: the hardcoded default is sufficient for dev.
title: Port model resolver: settings, scoped models, provider priority
